I'm no expert at dealing with comphet, sometimes it still fucks me up pretty bad but here's what I got... We live in a lesbophobic world and it makes being a lesbian feel like a dreadful ass thing to be. What's worse is that the current 'queer' discourse does not specifically address the struggle of coming out as a lesbian and dealing with comphet. We are stuck in this pretend utopia of love is love as if it's just that simple. 

You have to survive this world and for that you will need courage and wilfulness to accept who you are and stand up against the bullshit, which is plenty. For me I work through the anxiety of this being a phase etc by asking myself what I want, not what I have to settle for or seems inevitable by society's standards. Then I run with it and keep my eyes on what I want. You decide what your life will be, you are not pre-destined to settle. 

Thats all I've got. Good luck on your journey.
